## Principled 契约

所有条目是 numeric scalar；弧度在磁盘中保持弧度。硬域端点 null 表示无界，推荐范围不是强制裁剪。

| ID | 类型 / 单位 | 默认值 | 硬域 | 推荐范围 | 适用材质 | 视觉语义（原契约） |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `TerminatorDotCenter` | number / unitless_signed_dot | 0 | [-1, 1] | [-0.5, 0.5] | Generic, Hair | Signed N dot L response center; not shadow-map bias. |
| `TerminatorDotHalfWidth` | number / unitless_signed_dot_half_width | 0.05 | [0, 0.5] | [0, 0.25] | Generic, Hair | Artistic half-width in signed dot coordinates; zero retains pixel AA. |
| `SpecHalfAngleRad` | number / radian | 0.13962634015954636 | [0.017453292519943295, 1.0471975511965976] | [0.017453292519943295, 0.4363323129985824] | Generic, Face, Hair | Raw half-vector lobe 50 percent angular half-width; Hair uses the strand T section. |
| `SpecEdgeSoftness` | number / unitless | 0.15 | [0, 1] | [0, 1] | Generic, Face, Hair | Reference angular half-width = .95 * value * min(beta, pi/2-beta). |
| `SpecPeakScale` | number / linear_scene_multiplier | 1 | [0, 无界] | [0, 2] | Generic, Face, Hair | Peak amplitude before visibility/Fresnel; integrated energy not held fixed. |
| `NormalDetailStrength` | number / unitless | 1 | [0, 1] | [0, 1] | Generic, Face, Hair | Tangent-space detail attenuation, independent from macro abstraction. |
| `MacroNormalBlend` | number / unitless | 0 | [0, 1] | [0, 1] | Generic, Face, Hair | Spherical blend toward asset-authored guide normal; Unsupported without guide data. |
| `RimGrazingAngleRad` | number / radian | 0.13962634015954636 | [0, 1.5707963267948966] | [0.017453292519943295, 0.6108652381980153] | Generic, Face, Hair | Angular distance from silhouette, not pixels. |
| `RimEdgeHalfWidthRad` | number / radian | 0.03490658503988659 | [0, 1.5707963267948966] | [0, 0.17453292519943295] | Generic, Face, Hair | Artistic grazing-angle edge transition half-width. |
| `RimPeakScale` | number / linear_scene_multiplier | 0 | [0, 无界] | [0, 2] | Generic, Face, Hair | Linear amplitude with separate visibility policy. |
| `FaceAngularBiasRad` | number / radian | 0 | 无硬域 | [-0.08726646259971647, 0.08726646259971647] | Face | Positive postpones darkening; divide by pi when converting to half-turn field coordinates. |
| `FaceAngularHalfWidthRad` | number / radian | 0.03490658503988659 | [0, 无界] | [0, 0.17453292519943295] | Face | Critical azimuth half-width, not screen-space feathering. |
| `HairShiftAngleRad` | number / radian | 0 | [-0.3490658503988659, 0.3490658503988659] | [-0.3490658503988659, 0.3490658503988659] | Hair | Rotates T and N in their plane; root-to-tip orientation fixes shift sign. |
| `StrandAnisotropy` | number / unitless | 0.9 | [0, 1] | [0, 1] | Hair | Broadens raw angular lobe toward fiber stripe; not native GGX anisotropy. |
| `OutlineWidthPx` | number / output_resolution_pixel | 0 | [0, 无界] | [0, 4] | Generic, Face, Hair | Width at declared output resolution; requires separate outline backend. |
| `MatCapWeight` | number / unitless | 0 | [0, 1] | [0, 1] | Generic, Face, Hair | Requires named blend operator and texture. |

## S58 候选映射

Exact 必须连同 scope/condition 解读；坐标精确不代表最终画面精确。当前每项 implementation 和 renderValidation 如下；Unsupported 仅针对表列 scope。

| 语义 | 目标 | 质量 / 范围 | 实现 / 验证 | 条件 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| TerminatorDotCenter | UToonProfile DiffuseRamp center | Exact / CoordinateOnly | NotImplemented / NotRun | Single zero-size directional light, include-shadow off, no offset: (tau+1)/2; final appearance uncalibrated. |
| TerminatorDotHalfWidth | DiffuseRamp half-width | Approximate / Appearance | NotImplemented / NotRun | w/2 is coordinate-exact; LUT/filter/AA calibration required. |
| SpecHalfAngleRad | Roughness plus SpecularRamp | Approximate / Appearance | NotImplemented / NotRun | Fit native D*energy lookup; never use size=1-roughness. |
| SpecEdgeSoftness | SpecularRamp fit | Approximate / Appearance | NotImplemented / NotRun | View/light/roughness coupling requires measurement. |
| SpecPeakScale | SpecularRamp scale or calibrated multiplier | Approximate / Appearance | NotImplemented / NotRun | Specular/F0 is not an independent peak knob. |
| MacroNormalBlend | Normal preprocessing | Exact / DataPreprocessing | NotImplemented / NotRun | Valid authored macro normals required; otherwise Unsupported. |
| FaceCriticalAzimuthTerminatorPerLight | 无 | Unsupported / NativePublicInterface | NotImplemented / NotRun | No public per-light face-mask/NoL override; offset bridge is Approximate only. |
| FaceKeyLightOffsetBridge | PatternUV and prebuilt offset atlas | Approximate / CandidateOnly | NotImplemented / NotRun | Calibrate monotone interior range and inverse, 12-bit UV, frac/wrap seams; no endpoint Exact claim. |
| HairShiftAngleRad | 无 | Unsupported / IndependentNativeLobeShift | NotImplemented / NotRun | Changing shared Normal also changes diffuse/GI; Tangent alone is not an independent shifted reference lobe. |
| StrandAnisotropy | Toon Tangent and Anisotropy | Approximate / Appearance | NotImplemented / NotRun | Native anisotropic GGX differs; calibrate flow and anisotropy. |
| HairAngularLobeAllViews | 无 | Unsupported / ExactReferenceReproduction | NotImplemented / NotRun | Native GGX plus ramp is not generally identical to reference angular metric. |
| RimGrazingAngleRad | 无 | Unsupported / ToonProfileField | NotImplemented / NotRun | Separate appearance module; emissive rim does not acquire native visibility. |
| OutlineWidthPx | 无 | Unsupported / ToonProfileField | NotImplemented / NotRun | Separate geometry/screen module. |
